# Supply and Demand

## Shifts in supply

A change in a non-price determinant moves the whole supply curve.

{{< appfig supply_shift_1 caption="Figure 3.1: A rightward shift (S₀ to S₂) and a leftward shift (S₀ to S₁)." >}}

At a higher price the same shifts produce different quantities:
